verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing describes user-defined rules and custom workflows that run unattended: dynamic rules auto-provision and revoke access as roles change, and offboarding automatically triggers an AI-driven device retrieval flow. It frames this as "You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest," plus cross-system workflow automation. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the workflow builder (triggers, scheduling, conditions), independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of background automation beyond marketing-page claims.
